content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"Several accepted claims are not shown to have been investigated. Claims 4-6, 8-11, 13 and 14 (sick leave delay, the \"mental patient\" remark, the misconduct accusations, S1 pacing, the article on nurses with mental disabilities, splitting staff) get no witness findings or analysis, and the agency's decision never mentions them. Witness 13 and Witness 12, named as witnesses to the disclosure, are not addressed. The coworker who made the \"mental patient\" remark and the one who made the harassment accusation are not shown to have been interviewed. The privacy findings conflict: S1 said two coworkers were disciplined, while the Privacy Office letter is partly blank and identifies different coworkers. The discipline letters have unidentified addressees. The agency relied on the privacy-investigation interviews rather than EEO affidavits, and discounted Witnesses 1 and 2 as biased without any comparator or corroborating evidence. The 12-hour shift claim also has an unresolved date discrepancy (2017 versus 2018). The record is not adequate for a merits decision on the full harassment claim."}
